abstract: Let N_λ(X) count coprime triples a+b=c≤X with rad(abc)<c^λ. Bernert, Browning, Lichtman and Teräväinen (arXiv:2410.12234v2, Theorem 1.3) proved N_λ(X)≪X^{0.6+ε} for 0<λ<1, the exponent 3/5 being the value of a linear program assembled from their anatomic decomposition, Fourier and geometry-of-numbers bounds. Zhang (Zenodo, 29 August 2026) proved the uniform bound N_λ(X)≪X^{34/59+ε} for 0<λ≤1 by retaining all valuation layers of that decomposition. We develop an independent route through a new two-letter collision inequality and obtain N_λ(X)≪X^{59969/100033+ε}, with 59969/100033=0.59949…, for all 0<λ≤1. Freezing all but two powerful coordinates of two of the three letters, the free monomials x^j y^k with (j,k)=(2,3) or (3,4) satisfy a congruence modulo the frozen coefficient of the other letter. Because k−j=1, this congruence is parametrized by a single unit-group element, giving a sharp multiplicative-energy bound; the resulting shifts are controlled by a uniform bound for representations of a nonzero integer as a difference x^j y^k − x'^j y'^k, proved through ideal counting and absolute lower bounds for fundamental units of real quadratic and pure cubic fields. Adding the 24 instances of this inequality to the linear program of Bernert–Browning–Lichtman–Teräväinen lowers its value below 3/5; this is proved by a 777-leaf branch-and-bound tree with rational Farkas multipliers, checked by an independent standard-library verifier supplied with the paper. We also exhibit a feasible point with D=13/22, so these constraints cannot give an exponent below 0.5909…. The manuscript was produced with substantial AI assistance and has not been reviewed by a human expert.
author: lihongmin
change_summary:
- Retitled the paper; the previous title was 'Breaking the three-fifths barrier for the exceptional set in the abc conjecture'.
- Added a citation to H. Zhang, 'A uniform sub-three-fifths bound for exceptional abc triples', Zenodo, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22151481 (published 29 August 2026), which proves N_λ(X)≪X^{34/59+ε} uniformly for 0<λ≤1, in the abstract, in Section 1 (new paragraph and two sentences after the Main Theorem), in Section 7 (comparison of 13/22 with 34/59) and in Section 8.
- Section 8: replaced the sentence stating that no bound below 0.6 for N_λ(X) had appeared (arXiv searches up to 4 November 2026) by a description of Zhang's result and method and of the independence of the present argument.
- Added references [7] (Zhang), [8] (Heath-Brown, arXiv:2601.07817) and [9] (Salberger, Proc. LMS 2023).
- No change to theorems, proofs, the certificate or the supplement.
title: A two-letter collision inequality and a sub-three-fifths bound for the exceptional set in the abc conjecture
